published_record.title: Generic Cantor actions of Z wr Z are hyperfinite

row: 30006166 / OWR-14299082-012 — Iyer (joint Shinko), Oberwolfach Report 2/2025, Question 3, printed p.115; https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2025/2

Generic Cantor actions of Z wr Z are hyperfinite. Alec Kriebel; version 1.0.0, 2026-10-13. Full affirmative resolution: a dense G_delta in all continuous restricted Z wr Z Cantor actions has hyperfinite Borel orbit relation on the entire space, including the exceptional integer-height preimage. Auxiliary Borel theorem requires an equivariant profinite shift height and permits stabilizers. Compatible-lift predecessors and CJMST inputs credited; dated bounded priority audit, no firstness/current-worldwide-openness certification. Extensive OpenAI use; unrefereed, no completed external human peer review or formal verification.
